description: p68's input with one member added at its top level, `x_unknown_2026: 1`, a name composition_independence does not define, so the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p68 is the accepting twin: the same input without the member. The member and its value are the probe published in issue #17, which added it to every valid vector's input at 9be9eec, before this kind existed, and found all of them still valid. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json. README.md states what this vector pins (Composition: findings and the counterparty's decision).
